project_info.network_architecture: Cloud-based architecture with VPN/Direct Connect connectivity for customer-hosted systems, secure data ingestion through multiple channels (SFTP, Snow Family, AppFlow), centralized data lake with role-based access, and segregated compute environments for different user types
key_components: Data Ingestion Layer (Amazon AppFlow, AWS Transfer for SFTP, AWS Snow Family)
Data Storage Layer (Amazon S3, Amazon HealthLake, Redshift Data Warehouses)
Data Processing Layer (AWS Glue Crawlers, AWS Glue Data Catalog)
Machine Learning Platform (Amazon SageMaker, Amazon EC2)
Management & Security Layer (AWS IAM, AWS KMS, Amazon GuardDuty, Amazon Macie, AWS Config, AWS CloudTrail, Amazon CloudWatch)
